$comment: Machine-readable e2e scenario manifest for AI agents. Each scenario maps to a spec file; agents may also execute steps manually with a browser tool and must capture the listed screenshots into output/screenshots/<project>/. Viewport projects: desktop-1280, tablet-768, mobile-360.

scenarios.description: Public pages and the registration/login boundary.

Full order lifecycle across the three roles: buyer checkout, seller fulfilment, admin moderation. Tests run serially and share one database; the buyer test seeds cart/address/report through the app's own endpoints.

steps.note: seeded buyer; must be email-verified (seeders set email_verified_at)

steps.expect: buyer has a default address, a selected cart item, and a pending report
order is placed (COD, default shipping) and listed under /account/orders
order shows under To Ship; Arrange shipment moves it to To Receive
buyer's report appears in the moderation queue and can be approved

scenarios.description: Regression: admin routes render only the admin shell (no storefront chrome); pages that render their own shell are not double-wrapped.

Storefront chrome: product-card states (regular, discounted, frozen/halal, sold out, long name) snapshotted at 360/768/1280 in light and dark; category-nav states (default/hover/active/focus, no current item on home); WCAG contrast on price, old price, promo tag and nav text in both themes; footer trust strip, link groups, legal bar and sub-640px disclosures.

steps.expect: price is the strongest text; promo only on the -NN% tag; halal badge gated by category; sold-out card dimmed with tag
aria-current on the current category, 2px indicator, hover pill brand-50/700, 2px offset-2 focus ring; none active on /
contrast >= 4.5:1 for price, old price, tag, nav text in light and dark
trust strip, 5 link groups + brand block, legal bar; disclosures below 640px with aria-expanded

candidateNextScenarios: catalogue browse: / -> category -> product -> screenshot each
buyer marks order received + leaves a review
seller product create/edit with halal declaration
